categories/application-metier.metaDescription: Bookings, stock, time tracking, prospecting: concrete examples of custom business applications, with the problem each one solves.

content.text: A business application is software built for one specific activity: it follows your steps, your rules and your vocabulary, instead of forcing you into a generic tool. Scheduling, stock, quotes, bookings, time tracking: here are concrete examples I designed and delivered, with the problem each one solves.
For your own project, prices, method and timelines are on my
custom business software
page. To find out whether your business needs one, read the
business application guide for small companies
What each project solves
Izidoor
: booking and management for sailing, surfing, kayaking and ski schools. An unstable product turned into a platform used by about thirty organisations, handling several thousand bookings per season.
StockPME
: stock that no longer matches the shelves. Stock and inventory management across several warehouses, still used by small and mid-sized companies.
Gest-Time
: paper timesheets and spreadsheets. Time clocking and hours tracked per job site, still in production.
SignDex
: consistent email signatures and brand materials for the teams of LEXIAL, an international law firm.
DevLeadHunter
: manual prospecting. It finds craftspeople without a website, prepares a demo and sends the email campaigns.
GoupixDex
: scanning, pricing and listing Pokémon cards on Vinted and eBay, without retyping.
Driving School
: lesson scheduling and student tracking for a driving school (training project, 2021).
